title: Cech sheaf resolution with compatible local scalar actions
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $I$ an index type in the universe of $X$, $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ an open cover and $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. There exist a nonnegative complex $D$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, an augmentation $\epsilon:F[0]\to D$, and natural presheaf isomorphisms $e_p$ from the underlying global-ring module presheaf of $D^p$ to the usual Cech term [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] $B\mapsto\prod_{y:\operatorname{Fin}(p+1)\to I}F((\prod_lU_{y(l)})\cap B)$, satisfying the signed differential identity and the restriction-coordinate augmentation identity. There are also module-sheaf isomorphisms $D^p\simeq\prod_y j_{y,*}(F|_{\cap_lU_{y(l)}})$. For each $p,y,B$, write $c_{p,y,B}$ for the y-coordinate of $e_p(B)$. For all $a\in\mathcal O_X(B)$ and $s\in D^p(B)$ one has $c_{p,y,B}(as)=a|_{(\prod_lU_{y(l)})\cap B}\,c_{p,y,B}(s)$. Finally $\epsilon$ is a quasi-isomorphism. Empty covers and empty schemes are included.

proof.text: Obtain D, epsilon and e, together with the differential, augmentation, product-term and local-scalar equations, from the scalar-compatible construction. This construction needs no cover and asserts no quasi-isomorphism.

For every cover member U_i, apply augmented_cech_sheaf_quasiIso_restrict to the same D, epsilon, e and their differential and augmentation equations. This gives a quasi-isomorphism after restriction to U_i.

For the constructed augmentation epsilon, use quasiIso_iff, quasiIsoAt_iff and ShortComplex.quasiIso_iff to reduce to invertibility of each homology map. Restriction preserves finite limits and colimits, so ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_inv_naturality identifies the restriction of that homology map with the invertible local homology map obtained in step 2. Cancel the homology comparison isomorphism to obtain local invertibility. Apply the existing public Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isIso_pullback_map to the open immersions U_i -> X, which are flat and jointly surjective by hU. NatIso.isIso_map_iff for restrictFunctorIsoPullback converts the restriction results to pullback results. No separate isIso_of_restrict or quasiIso_of_restrict declaration is introduced. The same argument handles an empty cover of an empty scheme.

theorem exists_linear_cech_sheaf_resolution
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens) (hU : iSup U = ⊤)
    (F : X.Modules) :
    ∃ (D : CochainComplex X.Modules ℕ)
      (ε : (CochainComplex.single₀ X.Modules).obj F ⟶ D)
      (e : ∀ p : ℕ, (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).obj
          (D.X p).val ≅
        ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj
          ((prod.functor (C := X.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
            (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj F.presheafModuleCat)).X p),
      (∀ p : ℕ,
        (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
            (D.d p (p + 1)).val ≫ (e (p + 1)).hom =
          (e p).hom ≫ ((cechComplexFunctor U).obj
            ((prod.functor (C := X.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj F.presheafModuleCat)).d p (p + 1)) ∧
      (∀ (y : Fin 1 → ι) (V : X.Opens),
        ((PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
            ((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0 F).inv ≫ ε.f 0).val ≫
          (e 0).hom ≫
            Pi.π (fun y : Fin 1 → ι =>
              ((prod.functor (C := X.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
                (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj F.presheafModuleCat).obj
                  (op (∏ᶜ fun l => U (y l)))) y).app (op V) =
          F.presheafModuleCat.map (prod.snd : (∏ᶜ fun l => U (y l)) ⨯ V ⟶ V).op) ∧
      (∀ p : ℕ, Nonempty (D.X p ≅ ∏ᶜ fun y : Fin (p + 1) → ι =>
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (⨅ l, U (y l)).ι).obj (F.restrict (⨅ l, U (y l)).ι))) ∧
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (y : Fin (p + 1) → ι) (B : X.Opens),
        let c : Γ(D.X p, B) → Γ(F, (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ U (y l)) ⨯ B) :=
          fun s ↦ ((e p).hom ≫ Pi.π (fun y : Fin (p + 1) → ι ↦
            ((prod.functor (C := X.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj F.presheafModuleCat).obj
                (op (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ U (y l)))) y).app (op B) s
        ∀ (a : Γ(X, B)) (s : Γ(D.X p, B)),
          c (a • s) = X.presheaf.map (prod.snd :
            (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ U (y l)) ⨯ B ⟶ B).op a • c s) ∧
      QuasiIso ε
